headline: Board of Variances Reviews Haʻikū Zipline & Lumeria Maui Appeals

meeting.body: Board of Variances Reviews Haʻikū Zipline & Lumeria Maui Appeals
meeting.summary: The board continued a zipline appeal to January 28th and an MRC Partners LLC appeal to December 10th.
meeting.recap: The first item was an appeal of a violation notice over a zipline, related structures, statues, and photo sales.[[0:02:20]] The appellant's representative said both sides agreed to another continuance (a delay to a later date).[[0:03:07]] The representative said the conditional permit application was closed this year after their planner did not answer the department in time.[[0:03:24]] The representative said a second planner helped refile the application and addressed all items the department had asked for.[[0:03:48]] The planning department said it would ask in writing if it seeks a contested case (a formal hearing process).[[0:07:06]] The board agreed by unanimous consent to continue the zipline appeal to January 28th.[[0:07:33]] Members agreed the parties may give spoken updates instead of written ones.[[0:07:45]] On the second appeal, the appellant's representative said talks with the county are ongoing.[[0:08:47]] That appeal is by MRC Partners LLC, challenging a notice of violation.[[0:09:03]] The chair recalled saying at the last hearing that it was the last continuance.[[0:09:37]] The chair set November 27th as the deadline for any added documents.[[0:10:58]]
decided: The board agreed by unanimous consent to continue the zipline appeal to January 28th.
meeting.next: The appellant's representative said there may be another meeting with the county after the last proposal.

moments.q: Chair asks if the parties are close after calling it the last continuance
